figures.alt: Illustration of a girl pushing a red wagon away from her while a boy pulls a blue wagon toward himself on a playground.
figures.caption: A push sends something away from you. A pull brings it toward you.

figures.alt: Photo of a toy car on a cardboard ramp on a tile floor, with soft foam blocks placed as stoppers at the end of the ramp.
figures.caption: What a finished Safe Stopper test can look like: a ramp, a car, and a foam stopper.

figures.alt: Bar graph, How far the car rolled. Soft push 2 floor tiles, Strong push 6 floor tiles.
figures.caption: A soft push sent the car 2 floor tiles. A strong push sent it 6 tiles.

figures.alt: Bar graph, Times the car was stopped (3 tries). Foam stopper 3 stops out of 3 tries, Cardboard stopper 1 stops out of 3 tries.
figures.caption: The foam stopper stopped the car 3 times out of 3. The cardboard stopper stopped it 1 time out of 3.
